verdict.rationale: GitLab's own docs explicitly state the Linux package 'includes services and tools to install GitLab without laborious configuration' and offers scaling guides, directly matching the story. However, this is vendor-sourced documentation with no independent/community evidence confirming ease of self-managed installation, and community feedback focuses on operational reliability issues (crashes, backup failures) rather than install experience, so the claim remains unverified by hands-on evidence.
